title: SSC CGL
full_name: Staff Selection Commission Combined Graduate Level Examination 2026
description: SSC CGL is one of the most prestigious government exams in India for recruiting candidates to various Group B and Group C posts in ministries, departments, and organizations of the Government of India.
notification:
SSC CGL 2026 Notification will include:
• Total Vacancies: Expected 8000-12000 posts
• Post-wise vacancy details
• Reservation category-wise vacancies
• Zone-wise and State-wise distribution
• Detailed eligibility criteria
• Application fee: ₹100 (Women/SC/ST/PwD/Ex-Servicemen exempted)

Note: Exact dates and vacancies will be announced in the official notification.
eligibility:
Educational Qualification:
• Bachelor's Degree from a recognized University or Institute
• For Statistical Investigator: Bachelor's Degree with Statistics/Mathematics/Economics
• For Compiler: Bachelor's Degree with Statistics as main subject

Nationality:
• Must be a citizen of India
• Subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or Tibetan refugee (before 1962)
• Person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries

Other Requirements:
• Valid Aadhaar Card
• Active email ID and mobile number
age_limit:
Age Limit (as on January 1, 2026):
• For Assistant Section Officer (CSS): 20-30 years
• For Statistical Investigator: up to 32 years
• For remaining posts: 18-27/30/32 years (post-specific)

Age Relaxation:
• SC/ST: 5 years
• OBC: 3 years
• PwD (General): 10 years
• PwD (OBC): 13 years
• PwD (SC/ST): 15 years
• Ex-Servicemen (General): 3 years
• Ex-Servicemen (OBC): 6 years
• Ex-Servicemen (SC/ST): 8 years
syllabus:
Tier-I (Computer Based):
1. General Intelligence & Reasoning (25 Q, 50 marks)
   - Analogies, similarities, differences, space visualization
   - Problem solving, analysis, judgment, decision making
   - Visual memory, discrimination, observation
   - Relationship concepts, arithmetical reasoning
   - Verbal and figure classification, arithmetical number series

2. General Awareness (25 Q, 50 marks)
   - History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene
   - General Policy & Scientific Research
   - Current Affairs, Static GK

3. Quantitative Aptitude (25 Q, 50 marks)
   - Number Systems, Percentage, Ratio & Proportion
   - Average, Interest, Profit & Loss, Discount
   - Mixture & Alligation, Time & Distance, Time & Work
   - Geometry, Algebra, Trigonometry, Mensuration
   - Data Interpretation

4. English Comprehension (25 Q, 50 marks)
   - Spot the Error, Fill in the Blanks
   - Synonyms/Antonyms, Spelling
   - Idioms & Phrases, One Word Substitution
   - Improvement of Sentences, Active/Passive Voice
   - Direct/Indirect narration, Comprehension Passage

Tier-II (Computer Based):
• Paper-I: Mathematical Abilities (30 Q, 90 marks)
• Paper-II: Reasoning & General Intelligence (30 Q, 90 marks)
• Paper-III: English Language & Comprehension (45 Q, 135 marks)
• Paper-IV: General Awareness (25 Q, 75 marks)
• Paper-V: Computer Knowledge Module (20 Q, 60 marks)

Tier-III:
• Descriptive Paper in English/Hindi (Essay, Precis, Letter, Application)
salary_structure:

• Level-6 (₹35,400-1,12,400): Auditor, Accountant
• Level-7 (₹44,900-1,42,400): Assistant Section Officer
• Level-8 (₹47,600-1,51,100): Inspector (Income Tax, Excise, etc.)

Additional Benefits:
• Dearness Allowance (DA)
• House Rent Allowance (HRA)
• Transport Allowance (TA)
• Medical Benefits
• Pension (NPS)
• Leave Travel Concession
• Other allowances as per government rules"}
selection_process:
Stage 1: Tier-I Examination (Screening)
• Qualifying nature
• Marks counted for final merit

Stage 2: Tier-II Examination
• Multiple papers based on post applied
• Different cut-offs for different posts

Stage 3: Tier-III (Descriptive Paper)
• Qualifying nature (33% required)
• Conducted for specific posts

Stage 4: Document Verification (DV)
• Verification of certificates and documents
• Only for candidates who clear Tier-II

Stage 5: Medical Examination
• Final stage
• Conducted at nominated hospitals

title: RRB NTPC
full_name: Railway Recruitment Board Non-Technical Popular Categories 2026
description: RRB NTPC recruits candidates for various non-technical graduate and undergraduate posts in Indian Railways including Station Master, Goods Guard, Junior Clerk, etc.
notification:
RRB NTPC 2026 Highlights:
• Expected Vacancies: 35,000-45,000
• Graduate & Undergraduate posts
• Multiple RRB zones
• Application Fee: ₹500 (General/OBC), ₹250 (SC/ST/Women/PwD)
eligibility:
Educational Qualification:
• Graduate Level Posts: Bachelor's Degree from recognized university
• Undergraduate Level Posts: 12th (+2 Stage) or equivalent
• Typing proficiency for certain posts
• Computer literacy desirable

Nationality:
• Indian citizen
• Subject of Nepal/Bhutan
• Tibetan refugee (before 1962)
• PIO migrated from specified countries
age_limit:
Age Limit (as on July 1, 2026):
• Graduate Posts: 18-33 years
• Undergraduate Posts: 18-30 years

Age Relaxation:
• SC/ST: 5 years
• OBC (Non-Creamy): 3 years
• PwD (General): 10 years
• PwD (OBC): 13 years
• PwD (SC/ST): 15 years
• Ex-Servicemen: Up to 33/36 years
syllabus:
CBT Stage-I (Common for all posts):
• Mathematics (30 Q, 30 marks)
  - Number System, Decimals, Fractions
  - LCM, HCF, Ratio and Proportions
  - Percentage, Mensuration, Time and Work
  - Time and Distance, Simple and Compound Interest
  - Profit and Loss, Elementary Algebra
  - Geometry and Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics

• General Intelligence & Reasoning (30 Q, 30 marks)
  - Analogies, Completion of Number and Alphabetical Series
  - Coding and Decoding, Mathematical Operations
  - Similarities and Differences, Relationships
  - Analytical Reasoning, Syllogism, Jumbling
  - Venn Diagrams, Puzzle, Data Sufficiency
  - Statement-Conclusion, Decision Making

• General Awareness (40 Q, 40 marks)
  - Current Affairs, National and International importance
  - Games and Sports, Art and Culture of India
  - Indian Literature, Monuments and Places of India
  - General Science and Life Science (up to 10th CBSE)
  - History of India and Freedom Struggle
  - Physical, Social and Economic Geography of India and World
  - Indian Polity and Governance, Constitution
  - Environmental Issues, Indian Economy
  - General Scientific and Technological Developments

CBT Stage-II:
• Separate Computer Based Aptitude Test for certain posts
• Typing Skill Test for specific posts

selection_process:
Stage 1: CBT Stage-I
• First stage CBT
• Normalized marks
• 20 times the vacancies shortlisted

Stage 2: CBT Stage-II
• Separate for different levels
• Merit-based shortlisting

Stage 3: Skill Tests
• Typing Test (if applicable)
• CBAT (if applicable)
• Qualifying nature only

Stage 4: Document Verification
• Verification of original documents
• Medical fitness test

Stage 5: Final Merit List
• Based on CBT Stage-II performance
• Category-wise merit
